map.由样本比例与样本量求标准误 使用指南: Standard Error from Sample Proportion and Sample Size User Guide
map.输入样本比例 p 与样本量 n，按公式 SE=√[p(1−p)/n] 计算样本比: Enter the sample proportion p and sample size n to compute the standard error of the proportion from SE=√[p(1−p)/n], which measures the sampling fluctuation when estimating a population proportion and is used for proportion confidence intervals and hypothesis tests.
map.SE=√(p(1−p)/n)，样本比例抽样波动。: SE = √(p(1−p)/n), the sampling fluctuation of a sample proportion.
map.构建比例置信区间与 z 检验。: Build a confidence interval for the proportion and a z test.
map.n 越大 SE 越小。: The larger n is, the smaller the SE.
map.：SE=√(0.5×0.5/100)=√0.0025=0.05。比例估计波动约: : SE=√(0.5×0.5/100)=√0.0025=0.05. The proportion estimate fluctuates by about ±5%.
map.标准差描述数据本身离散；标准误描述统计量（如比例）的抽样波动，随 n 增大而减小: The standard deviation describes the spread of the data itself; the standard error describes the sampling fluctuation of a statistic (such as a proportion) and shrinks as n grows.
map.p 用样本还是真值？: Should p be the sample value or the true value?
map.通常代入样本 p 估计 SE；规划阶段用 p=0.5 得最大 SE。: Usually plug in the sample p to estimate SE; in the planning stage use p=0.5 for the largest SE.
